summary.text: Jervonte "Tae" Edmonds, a Democrat, represents District 88 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected on March 8, 2022, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Edmonds as a CEO and founder from West Palm Beach, born in Titusville, Florida.
The profile lists a B.A. from Florida Atlantic University (2015) and three children's books among Edmonds' highlights.
